title: Square Enix announces full remake of Romancing SaGa 3, launching February 16
summary: During the September 9 Nintendo Direct, Square Enix announced Romancing SaGa 3: Destinies United, a full remake of 1995’s Romancing SaGa 3. The title is set to release on February 16, 2027 for PC (Steam), PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and Nintendo Switch systems. This comes following the successful remake of Romancing SaGa 2 released in October 2024.

title: Kirby and the World Beyond, brand-new 3D action game in the Kirby series comes to Nintendo Switch 2 in Spring 2027
summary: On September 9, Nintendo and HAL Laboratory announced Kirby and The World Beyond, a brand-new 3D adventure in the iconic Kirby series. The game is set to release for the Nintendo Switch 2 in Spring 2027. According to the teaser trailer showcased during the Nintendo Direct livestream, players will be able to freely explore the world using a variety of Kirby’s copy abilities.

title: Fatal Fury: City of The Wolves coming to Switch 2 along with Tokyo Revengers collab
summary: SNK announced during the September 9 Nintendo Direct that Fatal Fury: City of the Wolves is headed to the Nintendo Switch 2. The Digital version will release on October 22, while a physical edition can be expected in January 2027. Additionally, in Season Pass 3, the game is scheduled to welcome two collaboration characters from the Tokyo Revengers manga and anime franchise: Manjiro Sano and Ken Ryuguji.

title: Danganronpa 2×2 gets January 14 release date
summary: On September 9, Japanese publisher Spike Chunsoft announced that Danganronpa 2×2 will be launching on January 14, 2027. Super Danganronpa 2×2 is a remake of Danganronpa 2: Goodbye Despair, the second installment in the Danganronpa series, originally released for the PSP in 2012. In Danganronpa 2×2, not only will the original main story be remade, but the game will also include a new scenario supervised by Kazutaka Kodaka, featuring completely different culprits, victims, and murder tricks. Danganronpa 2×2 is scheduled to release on January 14, 2027, for Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch 2, PS5, Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam/Epic Games Store).

title: Resident Evil 2 Deluxe, Resident Evil 3, and Resident Evil 4 Gold Edition coming to Switch on October 16
summary: Capcom announced during the September 9 Nintendo Direct that three Resident Evil titles (remakes) are coming to the Nintendo Switch on October 16: Resident Evil 2 Deluxe Edition (DLC included), Resident Evil 3, and Resident Evil Gold Edition. Pre-orders will begin later today on the Nintendo e-Shop.

title: Level-5 confirms Yo-Kai Watch 2 Haunted Domain, a remake of Yo-Kai Watch 2, is in development
summary: During the September 9th Nintendo Direct livestream, Japanese developer Level-5 announced that Yo-Kai Watch 2 Haunted Domain. The game appears to be a remake of 2014’s Yo-Kai Watch 2 Bony Spirits/Fleshy Souls/Psychic Specters. Release date is TBA.

title: Professor Layton and the New World of Steam releases December 10
summary: Level-5 announced during the September 9 Nintendo Direct that Professor Layton and the New World of Steam, the eighth mainline entry in the Professor Layton series, will release on December 10. Supported platforms are PC (Steam), Nintendo Switch and Switch 2, and PS5. A new trailer showcases the game’s puzzle gameplay, teasing that this title brings the series’ biggest mystery yet.

title: Meccha Chameleon comes to Nintendo Switch today
summary: During the Nintendo Direct, it was announced that the Steam best-seller Meccha Chameleon, developed by lemorion_1224 would release on September 9 for the Nintendo Switch. Mecha Chameleon is a multiplayer hide-and-seek game centered around drawing and camouflage. Players control a plain white character and compete in hide-and-seek matches across 3D maps filled with objects. The seeker must hunt down the hidden players, who are eliminated if shot.  The game recently celebrated over 20 million copies sold on its Steam version.

title: Monster Hunter Wilds coming to Nintendo Switch 2 on December 4
summary: Capcom announced during the September 9 Nintendo Direct that Monster Hunter Wilds will release for the Nintendo Switch 2 on December 4, containing all updates released so far. The Ascendance expansion pack is also on the way, with further information coming soon.

title: Zelda live-action movie officially titled “The Legend of Zelda”. Miyamoto hints at meaning behind lack of subtitle
summary: During The Legend of Zelda 40th Anniversary Direct, Nintendo announced that the upcoming live-action film based on the series will officially be titled The Legend of Zelda. Scheduled to premiere worldwide on April 30 exclusively in theaters, the film now has an official logo. Series creator Shigeru Miyamoto commented that fans will know why the movie comes with no subtitle once they see the film.
